request: Pull federal grants awarded to state, local, and education recipients from USASpending.gov (POST /api/v2/search/spending_by_award/), filtered to award_type_codes 02/03/04/05 (Block Grant, Formula Grant, Project Grant, Cooperative Agreement) and recipient_type_names in [State Government, County Government, City or Township Government, Special District Government, Independent School District, State Controlled Institution of Higher Education, Public/State Controlled Institution of Higher Education]. Fiscal year 2025-2026 (start 2024-10-01). Paginate via body 'page' with 100 per page, cap at 30 pages / 3000 rows. Enrich with amount_band (small<$100K / mid<$1M / large<$10M / mega>=$10M), award_kind (grant vs coop_agreement). Publish to 'Prep Agent / 22 - Federal Grants to SLED' on Tableau Server for state and local budget analysts tracking incoming federal funds.

sources.name: USASpending SLED Grants
sources.description: USASpending.gov POST /api/v2/search/spending_by_award/. Federal financial assistance (grants + cooperative agreements) to state, local, and educational institutions. award_type_codes: 02=Block Grant, 03=Formula Grant, 04=Project Grant, 05=Cooperative Agreement. Time window: FY2025-2026 (2024-10-01 to 2026-09-30). Body-mode pagination via 'page' param, page_size in 'limit', cap at 30 pages of 100 = 3000 rows. Sorted by Award Amount desc so the largest awards come first (Medicaid state Medical Assistance Program shows as ~$110B for CA — expected, this is the CMS Medicaid block-grant match to states).

recipient_type_names: State Controlled Institution of Higher Education
Public/State Controlled Institution of Higher Education

args.name: SLED Grants Trend
args.features_description: Row-level federal financial-assistance awards to state, local, and education recipients (FY2025-2026, capped at 3000 largest by amount). Fields include Award ID, Recipient Name, Award Amount, Total Outlays, Awarding Agency + Sub Agency, Award Type, award_kind (block_grant / formula_grant / project_grant / cooperative_agreement / other), amount_band (small<$100K / mid<$1M / large<$10M / mega), state/county/city, period_of_performance. Calendar features parsed from Start Date.
args.stats_description: Long-form SLED grants statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over state, Awarding Sub Agency, award_kind, amount_band). Includes 180-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies, lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Use to spot state-level spikes in incoming federal funds or shifts in the agency-mix funding a state.

outputs.name: SLED Grants Detail
outputs.description: Row-level federal financial-assistance awards to state, local, and education recipients (FY2025 through FY2026, 3000 largest by Award Amount). Award types: Block Grant, Formula Grant, Project Grant, Cooperative Agreement. Recipient types: State/County/City/Township/Special District Government, Independent School District, State Controlled Institution of Higher Education. Fields: Award ID, Recipient Name, Award Amount, Total Outlays, Awarding Agency, Awarding Sub Agency, Award Type, award_kind, amount_band (small<$100K / mid<$1M / large<$10M / mega), recipient_location_state_code/county_name/city_name, Start Date, End Date. Plus calendar features. Source: USASpending.gov API. Refresh: monthly.

outputs.name: SLED Grants Stats
outputs.description: Long-form SLED grants statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over recipient_location_state_code, Awarding Sub Agency, award_kind, amount_band). Includes 180-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Use to spot state-level spikes in incoming federal funds or shifts in the agency-mix funding a state.
